premise: Maya bets Leo that a plain grey pebble has air in it; the supply pod brings a brand-new oxygen plant, which bakes the pebble and fills its tanks, and Leo loses the bet.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Boy and the Filberts' and the riddle tales of the folk tradition, turned: the impossible answer is plain science, and losing the bet is the fun part.
lesson: Even ordinary things can hold something wonderful.
learning: Moon rock is nearly half oxygen: a machine that bakes it can free that oxygen for people to breathe.

en-US.title: Air from a Rock
en-US.text: {woman:enter} Maya held up a plain grey pebble. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [playfully] “Bet you there's air in this rock.” {man:enter} Leo {man:wobble} laughed. {man:says} “Air? In a rock? Bet there isn't. Loser does the washing-up.” {sfx:thud} Thump! Down onto the landing pad came the {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} supply pod. {supply-pod:live hold} Its side panels slid open. Inside was a box marked AIR. {man:face surprised} Out on the plain, the box unfolded into a brand-new {oxygen-plant:enter} oxygen plant. Maya {woman:go to oxygen-plant} tipped her pebble into its hopper. {woman:pulse} {oxygen-plant:live hold} {sfx:hum} Its oven glowed orange, its gauges swung up, and its tanks began to fill. {man:live} [gasps] Leo checked his wrist. Oxygen! Fresh air to breathe! Moon rock is nearly half oxygen, locked inside. Bake it hot enough, and out it comes. {oxygen-plant:sparkle} {man:face sad} [sighs] {man:says} “Fine. I'll do the washing-up.” [laughs] {woman:hop x2} And Maya took a deep breath of brand-new air.

es-ES.title: Aire de una roca
es-ES.text: {woman:enter} Maya levantó una piedrecita gris, de lo más normal. {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [playfully] «Te apuesto a que esta roca tiene aire dentro.» {man:enter} Leo {man:wobble} se rió. {man:says} «¿Aire? ¿En una roca? Te apuesto a que no. Quien pierda, friega los platos.» {sfx:thud} ¡Pum! Sobre la plataforma de aterrizaje bajó la {supply-pod:enter} {supply-pod:go to pad} cápsula de carga. {supply-pod:live hold} Sus paneles se abrieron. Dentro había una caja que decía AIRE. {man:face surprised} En la llanura, la caja se desplegó y se convirtió en una flamante {oxygen-plant:enter} planta de oxígeno. Maya {woman:go to oxygen-plant} echó su piedrecita en la tolva. {woman:pulse} {oxygen-plant:live hold} {sfx:hum} Su horno brilló naranja, sus agujas subieron y sus depósitos empezaron a llenarse. {man:live} [gasps] Leo miró su muñeca. ¡Oxígeno! ¡Aire fresco para respirar! La roca de la Luna es casi la mitad oxígeno, encerrado dentro. Si la calientas lo bastante, sale. {oxygen-plant:sparkle} {man:face sad} [sighs] {man:says} «Vale. Friego yo los platos.» [laughs] {woman:hop x2} Y Maya respiró hondo aquel aire recién hecho.
